en.title: Agent Skills for Coding, Testing and Debugging | Floatboat
en.description: Explore third-party Agent Skills for writing code, test-first development, debugging, React performance, and safe refactoring.

zh.title: 编程 Agent Skills：测试、调试与安全重构 | Floatboat
zh.description: 按具体编码任务查找第三方 Agent Skills：React 性能、测试驱动开发、故障诊断与安全重构。

en.title: Agent Skills for Coding Work
en.description: Use a focused instruction when the task is to change code: write a test, investigate a failure, improve a React implementation, or refactor without changing behavior.

zh.title: 面向编码任务的 Agent Skills
zh.description: 需要修改代码时，按任务选择指引：先写测试、调查故障、优化 React 实现，或在不改变行为的前提下重构。

intro.en: Coding Skills guide decisions inside an existing codebase. They do not supply a runtime, a repository, or permission to edit production systems. Read each source for its assumptions before applying it.
intro.zh: 编码类 Skill 指导已有代码库中的具体修改，但不会提供运行环境、仓库访问权或生产系统修改权限。使用前应阅读原始指令的适用前提。

en.title: Keep Code Changes and Reviews Together
en.description: Bring the task, repository context, tests, and review decisions into one workspace.

zh.title: 把代码修改与审查放在一起
zh.description: 让任务、仓库上下文、测试和审查决定留在同一工作空间。

en.title: A Behavior Change Needs Tests
en.description: Start with TDD when the expected behavior can be stated and checked before implementation.

zh.title: 行为变更需要测试
zh.description: 当预期行为能先被明确描述并验证时，优先查看 TDD。

en.title: A Failure Has No Clear Cause
en.description: Use diagnosis or investigation guidance to rank evidence before editing the suspected code.

zh.title: 故障原因尚不明确
zh.description: 先用诊断或调查指引整理证据，不要立即修改猜测中的代码。

en.title: A Codebase Needs Improvement
en.description: Choose React-specific guidance for performance issues, or Safe Refactor when behavior must remain unchanged.

zh.title: 代码需要改进
zh.description: 性能问题选择对应的 React 指引；需要保持既有行为时选择 Safe Refactor。

en.question: Are these Skills coding agents?
en.answer: No. A Skill is an instruction set used by a compatible agent. The agent, repository access, tools, and review process are separate.

en.question: Should I use TDD for every coding task?
en.answer: No. It is most useful when expected behavior is testable. An unclear requirement or exploratory design may need investigation first.

en.question: Can a Skill guarantee a safe refactor?
en.answer: No. Tests, diffs, and human review still have to confirm that behavior did not change.

en.question: Are all listed Skills built into Floatboat?
en.answer: No. This is an independent directory of third-party sources. Cards distinguish Floatboat's local guides from links to an original SKILL.md.

zh.question: 这些 Skill 本身是编程 Agent 吗？
zh.answer: 不是。Skill 是供兼容 Agent 使用的指令；Agent、仓库权限、工具与审查流程需要另外具备。

zh.question: 每个编码任务都适合 TDD 吗？
zh.answer: 不适合。预期行为可测试时更有价值；需求不清或仍在探索设计时应先调查。

zh.question: Skill 能保证重构安全吗？
zh.answer: 不能。仍需通过测试、差异审查和人工确认验证行为没有改变。

zh.question: 列表中的 Skill 都内置于 Floatboat 吗？
zh.answer: 不是。这是第三方来源的独立目录；卡片会区分本站详情指南与原始 SKILL.md 链接。

en.title: Agent Skills for Software Development Workflows | Floatboat
en.description: Find Agent Skills for planning an implementation, structuring React components, testing web apps, and understanding an existing system.

zh.title: 软件开发流程 Agent Skills：规划、架构与应用测试 | Floatboat
zh.description: 查找面向开发流程的 Agent Skills，覆盖方案澄清、组件架构、Web 应用测试和现有系统分析。

en.title: Agent Skills for Software Development
en.description: Development is broader than writing the next function. These Skills help clarify a plan, understand a system, organize component boundaries, and test a working application.

zh.title: 面向软件开发流程的 Agent Skills
zh.description: 开发不只是写下一段代码。这些 Skill 帮助澄清方案、理解系统、组织组件边界，并测试运行中的应用。

intro.en: Use this collection around the code change itself: before implementation when decisions are still open, and after implementation when the application needs realistic verification. For hands-on debugging and test-first coding, see Coding.
intro.zh: 这组指引关注代码修改前后的工作：实施前澄清决定，实施后以真实操作验证应用。若任务是具体调试或测试驱动编码，请查看“编写与修改代码”。

en.title: Keep Development Decisions Visible
en.description: Work with your files, implementation notes, and verification in one place.

zh.title: 让开发决策始终可追溯
zh.description: 把文件、实施记录和验证结果放在同一处继续工作。

en.title: The Plan Is Still Ambiguous
en.description: Use Grilling to expose missing choices and constraints before committing to an architecture.

zh.title: 方案仍有歧义
zh.description: 用 Grilling 找出尚未决定的选项和约束，再确定架构。

en.title: Components Are Growing Hard to Change
en.description: Composition guidance helps separate responsibility and avoid multiplying unclear prop combinations.

zh.title: 组件越来越难改
zh.description: 组合模式指引帮助划分职责，避免不清楚的属性组合不断膨胀。

en.title: The App Needs a Real Check
en.description: Webapp Testing focuses on running and inspecting the application, not only reviewing source code.

zh.title: 应用需要真实验证
zh.description: Webapp Testing 聚焦运行和检查应用，而不仅仅是阅读源码。

en.question: How is Development different from Coding?
en.answer: Coding covers concrete code changes, tests, and debugging. Development covers surrounding decisions, architecture, understanding an existing system, and application-level verification.

en.question: Does a planning Skill choose the product requirements?
en.answer: No. It can surface tradeoffs and missing decisions, but the product owner must still provide requirements and approve consequential choices.

en.question: Is reverse engineering a normal part of every project?
en.answer: No. Use it only when understanding a shipped application or binary is necessary and authorized; its tools require separate setup.

en.question: Are the tools included when I read a Skill?
en.answer: No. Read the original repository for prerequisites, permissions, and the difference between instruction files and supporting software.

zh.question: Development 和 Coding 有什么区别？
zh.answer: Coding 聚焦具体代码修改、测试与调试；Development 聚焦前后的决策、架构、现有系统理解与应用级验证。

zh.question: 规划 Skill 会替我确定产品需求吗？
zh.answer: 不会。它能暴露权衡和缺失决定，但产品负责人仍需提供需求并批准重要选择。

zh.question: 每个项目都需要逆向工程吗？
zh.answer: 不需要。只在确有必要且获得授权时使用；相关工具也需单独配置。

zh.question: 阅读 Skill 后就拥有所需工具吗？
zh.answer: 不会。请阅读原仓库关于前置条件、权限，以及指令文件和配套软件的区别。

en.title: Agent Skills for UI Design and Interface Review | Floatboat
en.description: Explore third-party Agent Skills for frontend design, interface critique, motion review, and accessible web interactions.

zh.title: UI 设计 Agent Skills：界面评审、动效与交互 | Floatboat
zh.description: 了解面向前端设计、界面审查、动效评审和网页交互的第三方 Agent Skills。

en.title: Agent Skills for Interface Design
en.description: Choose between creating an interface, reviewing one already built, and inspecting its motion or interaction behavior. They are different design jobs.

zh.title: 面向界面设计的 Agent Skills
zh.description: 新建界面、审查已有界面，以及检查动效和交互行为，是不同的设计任务；这里按任务区分相应指引。

intro.en: An instruction file can give a design review structure, but it cannot replace seeing the actual interface, checking accessibility, or testing interaction on the intended device.
intro.zh: 指令文件可以提供设计审查框架，但不能替代查看真实界面、检查无障碍支持，或在目标设备上测试交互。

en.title: Keep Interface Feedback in Context
en.description: Bring the page, design references, and review notes together before the next revision.

zh.title: 让界面反馈保留上下文
zh.description: 在下一轮修改前，把页面、设计参考和审查记录放在一起。

en.title: Starting a New Interface
en.description: Frontend Design and Design Engineering address visual direction and implementation quality from the outset.

zh.title: 从零开始做界面
zh.description: Frontend Design 与 Design Engineering 关注初期的视觉方向和实现质量。

en.title: Reviewing an Existing Page
en.description: Web Design Guidelines provides a review workflow for concrete UI issues rather than a generic style preference.

zh.title: 审查现有页面
zh.description: Web Design Guidelines 为具体 UI 问题提供审查流程，而不是仅凭个人审美判断。

en.title: Checking Motion and Feedback
en.description: Use motion-specific guidance when transitions, timing, or reduced-motion behavior needs attention.

zh.title: 检查动效与反馈
zh.description: 当过渡、时序或减少动态效果的支持有问题时，选用动效专门指引。

en.question: Can these Skills generate a finished design system?
en.answer: Not by themselves. They provide instructions; a coherent design system still needs product decisions, components, and testing.

en.question: Which Skill fits an existing UI review?
en.answer: Start with Web Design Guidelines for a broad review. Use Review Animations when motion is the specific concern.

en.question: Are design and frontend coding the same category?
en.answer: They overlap but are not identical. This category focuses on visual, interaction, and review decisions; Coding focuses on implementation changes.

en.question: Do these pages reproduce the publishers' full instructions?
en.answer: No. The original SKILL.md remains the source of truth. Floatboat provides independent summaries and links.

zh.question: 这些 Skill 能直接生成完整设计系统吗？
zh.answer: 不能。它们提供指引；完整设计系统仍需要产品决策、组件实现与测试。

zh.question: 审查现有 UI 先看哪个 Skill？
zh.answer: 广泛审查可先看 Web Design Guidelines；如果问题集中在动效，就看 Review Animations。

zh.question: 设计和前端编码是同一个分类吗？
zh.answer: 两者有交集，但不相同。本类聚焦视觉、交互和审查决定；Coding 聚焦实现修改。

zh.question: 这些页面会复制发布者的全部指令吗？
zh.answer: 不会。原始 SKILL.md 才是维护源；Floatboat 只提供独立摘要与来源链接。

en.title: Agent Skills for Writing, SEO and Marketing | Floatboat
en.description: Find Agent Skills for editorial review, SEO diagnosis, copywriting, content strategy, and social previews, with original publisher links.

zh.title: 写作与营销 Agent Skills：SEO、文案与内容策略 | Floatboat
zh.description: 按编辑审查、SEO 诊断、营销文案、内容策略和社交预览图任务查找第三方 Agent Skills。

en.title: Agent Skills for Writing and Marketing
en.description: An editorial review, an SEO audit, and a new campaign page require different evidence. Pick the instruction that matches the job rather than treating every marketing task as copywriting.

zh.title: 面向写作与营销的 Agent Skills
zh.description: 编辑审查、SEO 诊断与新营销页面所需的证据不同。按具体工作选择 Skill，不要把每项营销任务都当作文案撰写。

intro.en: These Skills organize marketing and editorial work; they cannot invent customer proof, verify a claim without sources, or replace measurement after publication.
intro.zh: 这些 Skill 可组织营销与编辑工作，但不能编造客户证明、在缺少来源时核实主张，或替代发布后的效果衡量。

en.title: Keep the Evidence Behind the Copy
en.description: Bring sources, page drafts, and review notes into the same working context.

zh.title: 让文案始终有证据支撑
zh.description: 把来源、页面草稿和审查记录放在同一工作上下文里。

en.title: Traffic Is Weak or Declining
en.description: Start with SEO Audit to investigate discoverability and site issues before rewriting copy.

zh.title: 流量低或持续下降
zh.description: 先用 SEO Audit 调查可发现性与站点问题，再决定是否需要改写文案。

en.title: A Page Needs Clearer Messaging
en.description: Copywriting addresses the page's claim, structure, and reader action; it still needs real product evidence.

zh.title: 页面表达不够清楚
zh.description: Copywriting 关注主张、结构和读者下一步，但仍需真实的产品证据。

en.title: The Editorial System Needs Direction
en.description: Content Strategy helps choose topics and priorities; Writing Guidelines helps review a particular draft.

zh.title: 内容体系缺少方向
zh.description: Content Strategy 帮助确定主题和优先级；Writing Guidelines 适合审查具体稿件。

en.question: Is SEO Audit a writing Skill?
en.answer: No. It investigates search and site problems. Copywriting and Writing Guidelines address different stages of the content work.

en.question: Can a Skill provide customer quotes or performance figures?
en.answer: No. Use verified sources and actual measurements; never fabricate proof to fill a page.

en.question: Is Content Strategy the same as writing one article?
en.answer: No. It helps select themes and priorities. An individual article still needs research, drafting, fact-checking, and editing.

en.question: Do I need a separate tool for social previews?
en.answer: The original Generate Social Preview Skill may depend on image-generation capabilities in the host environment. Read its source before use.

zh.question: SEO Audit 是写作 Skill 吗？
zh.answer: 不是。它调查搜索与站点问题；Copywriting 和 Writing Guidelines 对应内容工作的不同阶段。

zh.question: Skill 能提供客户评价或效果数据吗？
zh.answer: 不能。应使用经过核实的来源与实际数据，不能为了填充页面而编造证明。

zh.question: Content Strategy 等于写一篇文章吗？
zh.answer: 不等于。它帮助选择主题与优先级；单篇文章仍需调研、起草、事实核查和编辑。

zh.question: 做社交预览图需要额外工具吗？
zh.answer: 原始 Generate Social Preview Skill 可能依赖宿主环境的生图能力，使用前应阅读来源文件。

en.title: Agent Skills for Deployment and Browser Work | Floatboat
en.description: Compare Agent Skills for Vercel deployment, token-safe CLI work, optimization audits, browser automation, and webapp testing.

zh.title: 部署与浏览器 Agent Skills：Vercel、自动化与测试 | Floatboat
zh.description: 比较第三方 Agent Skills 在 Vercel 部署、令牌安全、优化审查、浏览器自动化与 Web 应用测试中的用途。

en.title: Agent Skills for Deployment and Browser Work
en.description: Shipping and checking a web app involves different permissions. Separate preview deployment, token handling, optimization audits, and browser-driven verification before choosing a Skill.

zh.title: 面向部署与浏览器任务的 Agent Skills
zh.description: 发布与检查 Web 应用涉及不同权限。先区分预览部署、令牌处理、优化审查和浏览器验证，再选择 Skill。

intro.en: These instructions do not grant Vercel access, supply tokens, or install a browser CLI. Confirm the project, account, and approval boundary before any operation that changes remote state.
intro.zh: 这些指令不会提供 Vercel 访问权、令牌，也不会安装浏览器 CLI。任何会改变远端状态的操作都应先确认项目、账号和审批边界。

en.title: Keep Deployments and Checks Traceable
en.description: Review the target, permissions, browser evidence, and next action in one workspace.

zh.title: 让部署与检查留有记录
zh.description: 在同一工作空间核对目标、权限、浏览器证据和下一步操作。

en.title: A Preview Needs Deployment
en.description: Deploy to Vercel is about checking project linkage and creating a reviewable deployment.

zh.title: 需要部署预览版本
zh.description: Deploy to Vercel 聚焦项目关联检查与可供审阅的部署版本。

en.title: A Token Is Involved
en.description: CLI with Tokens focuses on authentication boundaries and avoiding accidental exposure of secrets.

zh.title: 操作涉及令牌
zh.description: CLI with Tokens 聚焦认证边界，并避免意外暴露密钥。

en.title: The Running Site Needs Checking
en.description: Use browser or webapp testing guidance to inspect actual behavior; use Optimize for an evidence-led performance and cost audit.

zh.title: 需要检查运行中的网站
zh.description: 浏览器或 Webapp Testing 指引用于检查实际行为；Optimize 适合基于证据审查性能和成本。

en.question: Does a deployment Skill deploy without approval?
en.answer: No. It must operate within the user's account permissions and approval process. Read the original source for its exact workflow.

en.question: Is agent-browser only a Skill?
en.answer: No. The repository's primary product is a browser automation CLI; its companion Skill is an instruction entry point.

en.question: Do token instructions include a usable API key?
en.answer: No. They describe safer handling of credentials the user has already approved; they do not supply credentials.

en.question: What is the difference between browser automation and webapp testing?
en.answer: Browser automation controls a browser for a task. Webapp testing applies it to inspecting and checking an application's behavior.

zh.question: 部署 Skill 会无需批准就直接部署吗？
zh.answer: 不会。它必须遵守用户账号权限和审批流程；具体步骤应以原始来源为准。

zh.question: agent-browser 只是一个 Skill 吗？
zh.answer: 不是。该仓库的主要产品是浏览器自动化 CLI；配套 Skill 是使用它的指引入口。

zh.question: 令牌指引会提供可用 API Key 吗？
zh.answer: 不会。它说明如何更安全地处理用户已批准使用的凭据，不提供凭据。

zh.question: 浏览器自动化和 Webapp Testing 有何区别？
zh.answer: 浏览器自动化负责操控浏览器执行任务；Webapp Testing 将其用于检查应用的实际行为。
